title: Ceramic Residency at Craigardan
source_quote: We currently have electric kilns, a rocket kiln, and a wood kiln.
evidence_sentence: The ceramic studio page states the studio has electric kilns, a rocket kiln, and a wood kiln available to resident ceramic artists.
evidence_quote: We currently have electric kilns, a rocket kiln, and a wood kiln.
summary: A residency program for ceramic artists (and other disciplines) with access to a professional clay studio that includes wood, salt, electric, and rocket kilns. Summer residencies run May-November 2027; applications open October 15, 2026 and close December 15. Fellowship covers most costs; 2+ weeks minimum.
how_to_join: Apply via https://www.craigardan.org/apply during the application window (October 15 – December 15, 2026 for summer 2027 residencies). A completed application includes a $25 fee (waivable), CV, letter of intent, and work samples. Acceptance notice by January 15, 2027.
cost_text: Full cost $2300/week; Craigardan Fellowship of $1550/week is awarded to all accepted applicants, making resident cost $750/week. Additional financial aid available.
pay_text: Fellowship covers $1550/week of the $2300/week cost; resident pays $750/week plus transportation, materials, and some food.
